summary: Record every enrolled Core as the master of its own single-host pool at agent startup, replacing the BUG-0178/BUG-0182 no-record special cases; a single-member master may still join another pool. API impact: existing contract.

guide.reason: Operators already see each host as its pool's master; storage and VM workflows are unchanged and now work on single-host pools as documented.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. Inventory.managed.membership (existing field) is now reported by single-host Cores as a one-member pool with the host as ready master; the Controller already ignores membership whose master is the reporting host. The Core-local and peer join contracts are unchanged except that a single-member master may join. Documented in docs/API.md.

roadmap.reason: Aligns implementation with the existing pool master model.

state.reason: The pool membership record and pool CA are Core-owned.
state.record: pool-peer.json in the Core agent state directory on the pool master, created at agent startup.
state.recovery: A fresh Controller adopts it from the master's Inventory.managed.membership report; Core recreates it at startup if absent.

verification.method: go vet; go test -race ./internal/agent ./internal/localcore ./internal/controller. Regression tests refuse pool storage and inventory publication without a record and accept them once the single-host Core records itself as master; startup does not replace an existing record; both hosts in the join test start as single-host masters and the member still joins with lost-response recovery. The race detector found background work outliving an agent stop once single-host Cores have membership; Run now waits for its goroutines and the local handoff waits for scope recovery, and go test -race ./internal/localcore passed repeatedly afterwards. Not run on a lab host.
